_comment: Pinned sidecar downloads for scripts/fetch-binaries.ps1 and scripts/fetch-binaries.sh.
Each sidecar is saved as src-tauri/binaries/<name>-<target-triple>[.exe], matching externalBin in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json.
'triples' maps a Rust target triple to a platform key under each sidecar.
sha256 is the hash of the downloaded file. Every download is verified: a mismatch, or a pinned entry with an empty sha256, fails the script.
'pinned': false is only allowed as a temporary state; the scripts then print a loud warning with the computed hash.
yt-dlp hashes come from the release's SHA2-256SUMS file. ffmpeg hashes come from the release's SHA256SUMS.txt.
QuickJS-NG v0.18.0 publishes no SHA256SUMS file; its hashes are the sha256 digests GitHub lists for each release asset.

keepsake-ffmpeg.version: v1.1.0 (FFmpeg 7.1.1 minimal LGPL build for yt-dlp)

_comment: Android (arm64-v8a) executables for the in-process yt-dlp, read by scripts/fetch-android-binaries.sh/.ps1 and scripts/build-android-*.sh.
Not a 'triples' entry on purpose: fetch-binaries.sh would then demand every desktop sidecar for Android.
Each lib is placed at <jniLibsDir>/<name>; AGP packages it as lib/arm64-v8a/<name> and Android extracts it to nativeLibraryDir (the only app-owned exec location).

libffmpeg.so: prebuilt LGPL FFmpeg from https://github.com/Abdullah-Masood-05/ffmpeg-android-minimal-build/releases/tag/v1.0.0 (asset libffmpeg-android-arm64-v8a.so, installed as libffmpeg.so). sha256 comes from that release's SHA256SUMS.txt. sourcesUrl/sourcesSha256 = the release's LGPL corresponding-source tarball (FFmpeg/LAME/Opus tarballs + build.sh + sources.lock.json); the release job attaches it to every Keepsake release.
libqjs.so: the QuickJS-NG release asset, renamed. sha256 = the digest GitHub lists for the asset (release API 'digest' field); no SHA256SUMS file exists.
yt-dlp-ejs is NOT here: it is a pip pin in src-tauri/plugins/keepsake-media/android/build.gradle.kts and must move together with the yt-dlp pin.

libffmpeg.so.version: v1.0.0 (FFmpeg 7.1.1 minimal LGPL + LAME 3.100 + Opus 1.5.2, NDK r27c arm64 API 24)
